abstract: A case of spermatocytic seminoma intimately associated with rhabdomyosarcoma is reported. The patient, a 51-year-old man, presented with a two-year history of right-sided testicular enlargement. Orchiectomy was performed, and a large testicular tumor was excised. Further investigations during hospitalization revealed lung, liver, and retroperitoneal lymph node metastases. Further therapy was refused, and the patient died at home two months after orchiectomy. Autopsy was not permitted. Although the great majority of spermatocytic seminomas occur in pure form, do not metastasize, and have very good prognosis, in addition to the present case, seven cases of spermatocytic seminoma associated either with rhabdomyosarcoma or undifferentiated sarcoma have been reported. Presence of the sarcomatous element is associated with aggressive behavior, metastatic disease, and very poor prognosis. It is considered that the sarcomatous element develops from the spermatocytic seminoma by anaplastic transformation.
abstract_ja: 51歳の男性が、2年間の右精巣腫大を主訴に受診した。精巣摘除術を施行し、大きな精巣腫瘍を切除した。入院中の検索で肺、肝臓、後腹膜リンパ節への転移が判明した。その後の治療は拒否され、患者は精巣摘除術の2か月後に自宅で死亡した。剖検は許可されなかった。精子細胞性セミノーマの大部分は純粋型で出現し、転移することはなく、予後は非常に良好である。しかし、本症例に加え、横紋筋肉腫または未分化肉腫を合併した精子細胞性セミノーマが7例報告されている。肉腫様成分の存在は、攻撃的な経過、転移性疾患、きわめて不良な予後と関連する。肉腫様成分は、精子細胞性セミノーマから退形成性変化を経て生じると考えられている。
